turns.prompt:
Create a delivery promise bridge and node map for a holiday fulfillment command briefing. This is a presentation artifact, not an interactive dashboard. Keep it as one delivery promise bridge and node map in the first viewport.

Situation: Retailer: BrightCart. Nodes FC1, FC2, sort center S3, carrier Cobalt, carrier Mint, pickup stores P14/P22, customer promise cohort D+2.
Current state: FC1 backlog 18k red, FC2 backlog 6k amber, S3 sort SLA 91%, Cobalt on-time 82%, Mint on-time 94%, P14 pickup capacity full, D+2 at-risk orders 12,600.
Timeline: 07:00 backlog pull, 08:20 carrier scan, 09:10 store capacity, 10:00 promise review, 13:00 cutoff decision, 18:00 customer comms.
Sources: S1 WMS backlog, S2 sort telemetry, S3 carrier feed, S4 store capacity, S5 order promise engine, S6 comms draft.

Requirements: 1. The first viewport must be dominated by one coherent visual artifact, not a grid of detached KPI cards. 2. Show the main entities, current states, source markers S1-S6, timeline, legend, and four connected callouts. 3. The callouts must cover FC1 backlog, Cobalt on-time, P14 full, D+2 at risk. 4. Use polished domain-appropriate styling with readable labels and no critical overlap.

Reframe it for customer operations. Preserve the promise board; add exactly three customer-facing actions: protect D+2 cohort, shift volume to FC2, cap P14 pickup. Add two leader-linked lenses for Cobalt delay and FC1 backlog.

Update for 11:30: FC1 backlog drops to 11k amber, Cobalt improves to 88%, Mint falls to 89%, P22 becomes full, D+2 risk falls to 8,900. Recompute promise risk so D+2 improves but pickup capacity shifts from P14-only to P14/P22 constraint. Synchronize board, actions, node map, timeline, callouts, and change note. Do not leave P14 as the only full pickup site.
Turn it into an executive promise-risk one-pager. Fit promise bridge, node status, carrier ledger, source tags S1-S6, customer comms risk, and timeline in the first viewport.

Add a customer-service macro preview beside the one-pager. It must preserve D+2 at-risk 8,900, FC1 amber, Cobalt 88%, Mint 89%, P14/P22 pickup constraint, and source markers, but phrase the macro in customer-safe language. Keep the one-pager synchronized beside it.
